verdicts.reason: A rearranges for the banner, with the quote on the left and the can on the right, and the text wraps cleanly with no orphan. Flaws: the logo is moved off the text column to sit under the can on the purple circle, the gap between the quote mark and the quote is large and empty, and the sun icon is crowded against the top edge. B is the square layout shrunk and centred, leaving wide dead bands on the left and right. Its attribution and the SOLSTICE label are tiny and hard to read, the can is shrunk until it barely matters, and 'soon.' is still orphaned on its own line.
